name: The Road Outside the Walls
summary: The muddy trade road up to Glockmund. Your wagon stands here, oilcloth drawn over the spices — and over something you'd rather not show. The wheat fields go black in the dusk; the gate torches gutter far ahead. No one questions you here, but no one watches your back against night-road bandits either.
affordances: Sort spices and coins, plan your line
Be alone in the wagon (briefly drop the disguise at night)
Look at what's hidden under the oilcloth
